## Highlights since 0.16.9

- **Spell checking in your document's language.** Lattice reads the document language from babel or polyglossia. Other languages get spell checking with a dictionary downloaded on first use; English keeps spelling and grammar checks. Thanks to @quark67.
- **New project templates.** IEEE conference, IEEE journal and ACM (acmart).
- **Experimental Windows installer.** Each release now includes an unsigned Windows x64 installer. It is experimental; see [docs/windows-installer.md](https://github.com/leo1oel/lattice/blob/main/docs/windows-installer.md) before installing. Thanks to @LucasDavidTPE.

## Notable fixes

- "Install missing package" no longer gives up when several TeX Live packages provide the same file (such as `IEEEtran.cls`); Lattice lets you choose which one to install.
- Lower idle CPU use: no always-running animations, Overleaf checks pause while the window is hidden, and continuous file writes trigger fewer full project rescans.
- About Lattice and the Help menu link to the GitHub repository and the website. Thanks to @quark67.
- On Windows, the Overleaf sign-in window no longer opens blank. Thanks to @ivanvykopal.
